name: Meprodine
summary: Meprodine is an opioid analgesic that is an analogue of pethidine (meperidine). It is closely related to the drug prodine, the only difference being that meprodine has an ethyl group rather than a methyl at the 3-position of the piperidine ring.

pharmacology.text: Meprodine has similar effects to other opioids, and produces analgesia, sedation and euphoria.

uses.text: As with prodine, there are two isomers of meprodine, alpha-meprodine and beta-meprodine, with the alpha isomer having been more widely used.

sideEffects.text: Side effects can include itching, nausea and potentially serious respiratory depression which can be life-threatening.

fact.en: Meprodine differs from prodine, a pethidine relative once used in childbirth and dentistry, only by carrying an ethyl group instead of a methyl on its ring.
fact.zh: Meprodine 與 prodine 唯一的差別，是環上接的是乙基而不是甲基。prodine 是配西汀的親戚，過去曾用於分娩與牙科。
fact.zhHans: Meprodine 与 prodine 唯一的差别，是环上接的是乙基而不是甲基。prodine 是配西汀的亲戚，过去曾用于分娩与牙科。
